answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed reputation: an agent must lock a refundable deposit before offering services, and each completed job adds to a public, verifiable signal of reliability. A sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for every fake identity, so spinning up thousands becomes prohibitively expensive, and any identity caught cheating forfeits its deposit. A deposit is like a jade seal, costly to mint yet easy to verify, while reputation accrues like a karst landscape, shaped slowly by sustained honest work that a freshly minted fake cannot imitate.
